AllowedSecondaryValueContexts: data/production-phases.json — phase-specific overrides, not model-wide values
community contribution records — proposed/pending values, not canonical values
Policy: Current model-wide specifications, configuration and classification values have one active JSON source: boatmodels.json. Secondary active JSON may store provenance, evidence, relationships, resources, derived counts, phase-specific overrides, or proposed community changes, but not a second current model-wide value.
